description.value:
Gadgeteers see every gizmo and every tech power as parts of the same toolkit. Rather than settling on one killer app, they build a modular harness stuffed with small, clever inventions, forever adding another gadget wherever they find room.

What ties their inventory together is a knack for protecting the people around them: barriers of light and energy spring up to catch blows meant for their allies, and their whole approach to a fight involves layering just one more contingency onto whatever plan is already in motion.
